invariants.rule: Species scale is represented by a canonical scale_profile_ref and provenance; resolution belongs to shared rules/modifier owners.
Every executable species movement declaration is a typed reference to a shared canonical record and rules profile.
Every executable species sense declaration is a typed reference to a shared canonical record and rules profile.
Derived scale/movement/sense values reference registered rules profiles; species records may not embed duplicate formulas.
MVPS must not create movement, sense/perception, or scale-resolution engines; it integrates shared owners by reference.
Morphology can be referenced as a structural applicability requirement, but body structure alone does not grant locomotion or senses.
MVPS-04 may reference movement/perception capabilities but does not own survival/environment tolerance semantics reserved for MVPS-05.
MVPS-04 base integration contracts do not define transformation or form replacement semantics reserved for MVPS-09.

enforcement.ci_step: Run MVPS-04 scale movement sense regressions
